reported.title: Base64 conversion loop advances by 7 instead of 6

reported.claim: The condition for raising an error is inverted; it raises when the index IS valid (`0 <= index < len(symbols)`) and proceeds to crash or misbehave when the index is invalid.
reported.title: Move-to-front decode raises for valid indices

reported.claim: The count is decremented instead of incremented when consecutive characters are found, leading to negative counts in the encoded output.
reported.title: Run-length encode decrements repeat count

reported.claim: After the main merge loop, `i` has already been incremented past the last consumed element of `nums1`, so slicing with `nums1[i + 1:]` skips the first remaining element.
reported.title: Merge skips first remaining element from first array

reported.claim: The loop range for updating inner matrix cells is `range(1, cols - 1)`, which excludes the last column (index `cols - 1`). This means cells in the last column are never zeroed if their row or column marker indicates they should be.
reported.title: Matrix zeroing loop omits last column

reported.claim: The line `maximum = max(0, maximum)` incorrectly initializes the bucket's maximum to at least 0, causing incorrect results when all values in the bucket are negative.
reported.title: Fenwick update forces bucket maximum to at least zero

reported.claim: The loop iterates over elements_list[2:], skipping the second element of the input sequence.
reported.title: Linked list construction skips second input element

reported.claim: The condition `number_of_bands >= 3 or number_of_bands <= 6` is always true for any integer, so invalid band counts (like 1 or 2) are not rejected.
reported.expected: ValueError: Invalid number of bands. Resistor bands must be 3 to 6
reported.title: Resistor band-count validity check is always true

reported.claim: The condition `years_to_repay <= 0 or isinstance(years_to_repay, int)` raises an error for valid positive integer inputs because the second part of the OR is always true for integers.
reported.title: Valid integer repayment years are rejected

reported.claim: The condition `if fraction <= 0 and fraction > 1` is never true, so invalid fraction values (like 0 or 1.5) are not rejected.
reported.expected: ValueError: fraction must be between 0 and 1 (exclusive for 0, inclusive for 1)
reported.title: Fractional Kelly validation never rejects invalid fractions

reported.claim: The cross product calculation uses `point_a.y + origin.y` instead of `point_a.y - origin.y`, leading to incorrect orientation checks and wrong convex hull results.
reported.title: Cross product uses addition instead of subtraction for y offset

reported.claim: The initial sum is calculated for k-1 elements instead of k, causing the first window sum to be incorrect.
reported.title: Initial window sum omits one element

reported.claim: The counter `count` is initialized to 1 instead of 0, causing the function to return one more than the actual number of islands.
reported.title: Island count starts at one instead of zero

reported.claim: The maximum flow is calculated by subtracting the path flow instead of adding it.
reported.title: Ford-Fulkerson subtracts path flow from max flow

reported.claim: The condition `if self.tokens > 1` prevents the last token from being used, effectively reducing the bucket's capacity by 1.
reported.title: Token bucket cannot consume the final token

reported.claim: The function returns `refraction_sine` instead of the calculated `refraction_angle`.
reported.title: Returns refraction sine instead of refraction angle

reported.claim: The arguments to binary_search_by_recursion are passed in the wrong order (item and sorted_collection are swapped).
reported.title: Exponential search passes arguments to binary search in wrong order

reported.claim: The condition for selecting a full group of five elements is inverted, causing the median to be computed over a suffix of the array instead of a fixed-size chunk.
reported.title: Median-of-medians group selection condition is inverted

reported.claim: The cost accumulator is decremented instead of incremented, resulting in a negative total cost.
reported.title: Reversort cost accumulator is decremented

reported.claim: The loop iterates only up to `len(first_str) - 1`, ignoring the last character of both strings, causing anagrams that differ only in the last letter to be incorrectly reported as equal.
reported.title: Anagram check ignores final character

reported.claim: The function returns the input message string instead of the calculated match score.
reported.title: Returns message instead of frequency match score
